outGoing | Software Engineer | Lisbon, Portugal | HYBRID | €25k–€35k + meal allowance + health insurance

Started in Lisbon's local events scene and now work across festivals, sports and cultural events of every kind. We've raised our first round and are launching new products soon, so this is an early hire with real ownership.

You'll ship features across the whole product, work with product and design on what we build next, learn directly from the founders, and take part in on-call for what you ship. We care more about how fast you learn and how much you own than about years of experience.

Portuguese and English. You need to live in Portugal or already have the right to work in the EU (no visa sponsorship). Process: a 30 minute call with a founder, then a technical interview.

Apply: https://idealjob.app/jobs/outgoing/1?utm_source=hackernews&u...

Early-stage Startup | Software Engineer & Data Analyst | Full-Time | REMOTE (US & US Citizen) | $100,000 - $180,000 USD

We’re hiring for two roles: a strong generalist Software Engineer and a Data Analyst.

For the Software Engineer role, we’re looking for someone with solid technical ability and strong computer science fundamentals. Experience building reliable systems, performance optimization, clean architecture, and solving complex problems matters more to us than any specific tech stack.

For the Data Analyst role, we’re looking for someone who can turn messy data into clear insights. Strong SQL/Python skills and the ability to drive product and business decisions with data are key.

Some reasons you may enjoy working with us:

* Collaborative and innovative environment where your voice is heard * Fully remote with flexible hours * Long-term, full-time role (not a fixed-term contract) * High ownership and interesting technical/data challenges * Work with a talented team shipping products customers use every day

Only US and Canadian applicants will be considered.

If you’re interested, send your resume to pauly.devy@kaveronix.com and mention which role you’re applying for.

Common Prefix | Senior Software Engineer | Athens, Greece / REMOTE | Full-time | $80k to $160k + equity + bonus

We're hiring Senior Software Engineers!

Please apply through the form linked below. We only review applications submitted through the form, not by email. No recruiting agencies.

We're a mix of scientists (professors, PhDs, and postdocs from Stanford, Imperial, ETH Zürich, and Edinburgh) and engineers with decades in hedge funds, TradFi, and Web3. We lead Axelar, the network that moves assets and messages between blockchains, and work with teams like Ripple, Mysten Labs, Flashbots, and Celestia.

We’re looking for engineers with 5+ years of experience and a strong track record of shipping software to production. You’ve owned core parts of what you built, not just the edges, and you like working from first principles. No blockchain experience needed. We mostly use Rust, Go, and TypeScript.

You can work remotely or from our office in Athens. On top of that, you get unlimited time off, a budget for your laptop and home office, a yearly offsite somewhere cool, and 2 to 3 conferences a year. Most of what we build is open source: https://github.com/commonprefix

Role: https://commonprefix.notion.site/seniorswe-folk

Apply (we only review applications sent through this form; NO recruiters): https://commonprefix.notion.site/2b7bf672de828051b53cdd37811...
